h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kollam

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Kollam

c: Kollam lies between the Arabian Sea and Ashtamudi Lake, and its parks and beach walkways see steady use from early morning. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Kollam to civic bodies, schools, colleges, housing colonies and industrial units. Our Fun Fitness range is manufactured at our factory in Vasai, about 1230 km away, and delivered by road for installation.

Kollam is also a cashew-processing town, and a factory with a large workforce can set up a small gym near its canteen or gate. For any site this close to salt water, the materials matter. Every frame we make is galvanised, and we recommend a fresh-water rinse every few weeks for machines near the beach or the lake. A slightly raised base helps through the heavy monsoon that begins in June.

items.q: How should we maintain gym equipment near Ashtamudi Lake or the beach?
items.a: Rinse the machines with fresh water every few weeks, check the bolts and moving parts, and keep the base free of sand. Galvanised frames resist salt air, and we share a maintenance routine at handover.

items.q: Can a factory in Kollam set up an outdoor gym for staff?
items.a: Yes. A few machines near the canteen or gate are enough to start. Send us the area and the number of people likely to use it, and we will suggest a set and a layout.

items.q: What warranty comes with your outdoor gym equipment?
items.a: Three years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions.
